pages.text: Forbidden & Arcanus provides $(t3)T3$() dark magic, new materials, and the Arcane Crystal crafting system.$(br2)$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Arcane Crystals are a unique $(t3)T3$() crafting material used in several cross-mod recipes. The mod's Runic Ritual system supplements Occultism for advanced $(t3)T3$() magic crafting.$(br2)$(bold)Mundabitur Dust:$() Key material for $(t3)T3$() $(thing)Archmage$() and $(thing)Battlemage$() gear enhancement paths.$(br2)$(bold)Stellarite:$() $(t4)T4$() material from Forbidden & Arcanus. Requires deep $(t3)T3$() investment to produce. Used in several $(t4)T4$() endgame recipes.$(br2)Craft the $(bold)Tome of Arcana$() for the full Forbidden & Arcanus reference — Arcana magic, cursed items, and Corruptus lore.
